frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole organism with long backward tubular head crest, not isolated skull or substituted species.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: ROM 768 holotype, Fig.1 of Bertozzo et al. doi:10.1111/joa.13363. Missing tail series, most hindlimbs and distal ischia reconstructed comparatively. Fossil death posture and pathological spinal gap are NOT normal living anatomy.

scale.basis: NHM genus-level approximate size, used as artistic adult target; not a measured ROM768 complete length.

uncertainties: Soft tissue, colour and exact limb/tail proportions are reconstructed; no skin-colour claim.
Crest is hollow internally but mesh may use a solid lowpoly silhouette; do not add arbitrary exposed nostril tube openings.
No asserted neck frill/web, snorkel function, crest-to-back contact or pathological back saddle.
